title: Scholarship Program for Coconut Farmers and their Families (CoScho)
legal_basis: RA No. 11524; CHED-PCA JMC No. 1 s. 2023
description: Scholarship for registered coconut farmers in NCFRS or their dependents pursuing agriculture-related undergraduate degrees. Does not cover tuition at SUCs (FHE-aligned); provides cost-of-living stipend and allowances.
academic_requirements: GWA at least 80% for SHS/college applicants; pass SUC entry requirements
income_requirements: Combined annual gross income of parents not exceeding PHP 300,000
geographic_restrictions: National; apply through CHED Regional Office
benefits: PHP 70,000/AY stipend; PHP 10,000 books; PHP 30,000 laptop; PHP 25,000 thesis; PHP 10,000 OJT
benefit_summary: Cost-of-living stipend and allowances (no SUC tuition—FHE aligned); 1:1 return service in coconut industry
maintaining_requirements: Good academic standing per CMO guidelines
renewal_rules: Per academic year per implementing guidelines
return_service: 1 year per year of scholarship within 2 years after graduation in coconut-related sectors
evidence_snippet: Legal Bases: RA No. 11524; income cap PHP 300,000; NCFRS registration required; AY 2025-2026 call deadline July 31 2025

title: Scholarship Grant Program for Children and Dependents of Sugarcane Industry Workers and Small Sugarcane Farmers (SIDA-SGP)
description: Scholarship for children and dependents of sugarcane industry workers and small sugarcane farmers certified by SRA, covering undergraduate and graduate programs in sugar technology, chemical engineering, agricultural mechanics, and related fields.
academic_requirements: Pass SUC entry requirements; SRA certification required
income_requirements: Undergraduate: combined annual gross income not exceeding PHP 400,000; Graduate: PHP 500,000
benefits: Undergraduate: PHP 110,000/AY (PHP 10,000/month stipend + books); thesis/OJT PHP 75,000; conference PHP 15,000
benefit_summary: PHP 110,000/AY undergraduate package plus thesis and conference allowances; 1:1 return service
return_service: 1 year per year of scholarship within 2 years after graduation
evidence_snippet: RA 10659; undergraduate stipend PHP 100,000 + books PHP 10,000 = PHP 110,000/AY; income cap PHP 400,000 undergraduate

title: CHED Scholarship Program for Future Statisticians (Estatistikolar)
legal_basis: CMO No. 10 s. 2022; CMO No. 14 s. 2025
description: Scholarship for students enrolled in BS Statistics, BS Applied Statistics, and PSA-identified programs at CHED-recognized HEIs to develop national statistics and data science capacity.
academic_requirements: SHS graduate min GWA 85%; 2nd-4th year college min GWA 80%
income_requirements: Combined annual gross income not exceeding PHP 500,000
geographic_restrictions: Apply online to CHED Regional Office
benefits: SUC: PHP 80,000/AY (stipend + books/connectivity); PHEI: PHP 120,000/AY including tuition subsidy
benefit_summary: Tuition/stipend/books package; SUC FHE-aligned; TES harmonized exclusivity
evidence_snippet: AY 2025-2026 open; deadline August 15 2025; income cap PHP 500,000; SHS GWA 85% / college GWA 80%

title: Scholarships for Instructors' Knowledge Advancement Program (SIKAP)
description: Graduate scholarship for full-time teaching and non-teaching personnel of CHED-recognized HEIs and MOU partner agencies to pursue Master's or Doctorate at CHED-identified DHEIs. SIKAP-N pathway for non-regular personnel.
academic_requirements: Admitted to graduate program; full-time HEI employment; max age 50 per research (verify CMO)
benefits: Tuition, stipends, thesis allowances per CMO No. 9 s. 2025
benefit_summary: Comprehensive graduate funding for HEI personnel; 1:1 return service in higher education
return_service: Return service in HEI sector per CMO
evidence_snippet: SIKAP provides scholarships for teaching/non-teaching HEI personnel to pursue Master's or Doctorate at CHED-identified DHEIs

title: DOST-SEI Junior Level Science Scholarship — Merit Track
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI)
description: Merit track of JLSS for regular second-year college students in DOST-SEI priority S&T courses with high aptitude in science and mathematics. No income ceiling. Exam fee PHP 200 unless waived.
eligible_courses_specific: DOST-SEI priority S&T courses at identified HEIs
academic_requirements: Regular 2nd year; GWA at least 83% with no failing/conditional marks
benefits: PHP 8,000/month stipend; PHP 10,000/yr books; tuition up to PHP 40,000/yr private; thesis PHP 10,000
benefit_summary: Standard DOST-SEI privilege package; 1:1 S&T return service in field
maintaining_requirements: Maintain GWA and load requirements per scholarship agreement
return_service: 1:1 ratio full-time S&T employment in the Philippines
evidence_snippet: Merit track under RA 2067; no income cap; JLSS open to regular second-year students GWA 83%; exam fee PHP 200

title: DOST-SEI Junior Level Science Scholarship — RA 7687 Track
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI)
description: Need-based JLSS track for talented students whose household socio-economic indicators do not exceed DOST-SEI cut-off values. Requires utility bills and tax exemption documentation.
academic_requirements: Regular 2nd year; GWA at least 83%; 4-year barangay residency certification
income_requirements: Household socio-economic indicators within RA 7687 cut-off values
benefits: Same privilege package as Merit track; exam fee exempt
benefit_summary: DOST-SEI JLSS package for economically disadvantaged; 1:1 S&T return service
return_service: 1:1 ratio S&T employment in the Philippines
evidence_snippet: RA 7687 provides scholarships to talented students whose families' socio-economic status does not exceed set cut-off values

title: DOST-SEI Junior Level Science Scholarship — RA 10612 Track
provider: Department of Science and Technology - Science Education Institute (DOST-SEI)
description: Teacher-track JLSS for graduates committed to teaching STEM full-time in secondary schools. No restrictive income limits. DepEd provides deployment support.
benefits: Same DOST-SEI privilege package as other JLSS tracks
benefit_summary: JLSS package with teaching return service minimum 2 years in secondary schools
return_service: Teach STEM full-time in secondary school minimum 2 years; DepEd priority deployment
evidence_snippet: RA 10612 fast-tracks graduates to teach science and mathematics in secondary schools throughout the country

title: OWWA Education and Livelihood Assistance Program (ELAP)
description: Humanitarian educational and livelihood assistance for dependents of deceased active OWWA members or dependents of OFWs incarcerated/convicted with death penalty abroad.
academic_requirements: Standard passing marks; eldest dependent max 21 years for tertiary
income_requirements: Survivor benefit—deceased/incarcerated OFW must have been active OWWA member
geographic_restrictions: Apply at OWWA Regional Welfare Office
benefits: Elementary PHP 5,000/yr; High school PHP 8,000/yr; College PHP 10,000/yr; spouse livelihood PHP 15,000 one-time
benefit_summary: Multi-level educational assistance plus PHP 15,000 livelihood grant for surviving spouse
evidence_snippet: Educational assistance PHP 5,000 elementary PHP 8,000 secondary PHP 10,000 college per school year; livelihood PHP 15,000

title: Shell–PhilDev Scholarship Program
provider: Pilipinas Shell Foundation, Inc. / PhilDev Foundation
description: STEM scholarship for high-potential students with limited financial means at partner universities. Support begins second year of college through graduation with mentorship and industry exposure.
academic_requirements: High-performing sophomore-level STEM students at partner HEIs
income_requirements: Financial need—specific threshold not published on program page
benefits: Comprehensive financial assistance from 2nd year; mentorship; internship pathways at Shell
benefit_summary: STEM funding from 2nd year through graduation plus PhilDev mentorship; 215 scholars as of 2025
evidence_snippet: Assistance begins in scholars' second year; 215 scholars nationwide as of 2025; partner universities across Luzon Visayas Mindanao

title: Iskolar ng LANDBANK Program
description: Scholarship for children/grandchildren of agrarian reform beneficiaries, small farmers, and fishers from 60 poorest provinces. Administered by LCDFI with partner SUC enrollment.
academic_requirements: SHS graduate min 90% GWA or top 10%; principal endorsement
income_requirements: Total annual family income not exceeding PHP 300,000
benefits: PHP 100,000/AY for allowance books clothing; OJT at Landbank branches
benefit_summary: PHP 100,000 annual grant; 60 scholars/year 2023-2028; OJT pipeline at Landbank
maintaining_requirements: No other external scholarship; good academic standing
evidence_snippet: Program for ARB/small farmer/fisher dependents; PHP 100,000/AY; 60 scholars per year through 2028—official page content unavailable; contact LCDFI

title: UNILAB Foundation Educational Grant (Silliman University Medical School)
description: Institutional partnership grant for qualified Doctor of Medicine students at Silliman University with full tuition subsidy and monthly living allowance.
academic_requirements: Qualified medical students at Silliman University per MOA criteria
benefits: Full tuition subsidy and monthly living allowance
benefit_summary: Full tuition + monthly allowance for MD at Silliman; institutional partnership not open national portal
evidence_snippet: MOA signed Nov 28 2017; qualified students pursue Medicine with full-tuition subsidy and monthly living allowance

title: Analog Devices Academe Linkage Scholarship Program
description: Institutional-partnership scholarship with no public consumer portal. Partner HEIs (e.g., Mapua, Saint Louis University) nominate top ECE/EE/Computer Engineering students for ADI technical exam and interview; tuition billed directly to ADI.
academic_requirements: Top 10 students in batch during 2nd or 3rd year at partner HEI
geographic_restrictions: Partner HEIs only (Mapua University, Saint Louis University confirmed in research)
benefits: Full tuition/matriculation billed to ADI; recruitment pipeline to test/product engineering roles
benefit_summary: Internal HEI nomination only; no open public application; direct corporate billing and hiring pipeline
maintaining_requirements: Technical exam and ADI engineer interview
return_service: Employment pathway at Analog Devices upon graduation
evidence_snippet: Institutional pipeline: partner HEI selects top students; ADI technical exam; tuition billed to corporation; no public portal
